title: ABM Pilot (Regulated Workloads) — Metrics Dashboard Spec (Engagement → Meetings → POC → Security Review → Procurement)
content:
Purpose
- Define the minimum viable metrics + HubSpot field usage for the 6–8 week ABM pilot (Regulated Workloads: FinServ + Healthcare).
- Ensure weekly reporting is consistent across Sales/Marketing/SE/Security: engagement → meetings → POC → security review → procurement.
- Keep definitions questionnaire-ready and audit-friendly (no vanity metrics presented as outcomes).

Owners / consumers
- Owner (reporting + hygiene): Isabelle Laurent (Sales Ops Analytics)
- Marketing Ops implementation: Tyler Benson
- Weekly readout audience: Jordan Blake (CRO), Camila Reyes, Stephanie Nguyen, Lukas Meyer, Markus Klein, Dr. Aisha Rahman

Reporting cadence
- Weekly snapshot: every Monday 9:00am PT (pull Friday EOD numbers)
- Mid-week check: Wednesday EOD for email experiments and landing page conversion
- End-of-pilot retro: week 8 (freeze cohort definitions at pilot end date)

Scope boundaries (what we will / won’t measure)
IN
- ABM target account engagement, meetings booked, POC scoped/started/completed, security review progress, procurement signals, pipeline created/influenced.
- Vertical splits (FinServ vs Healthcare), region splits (NA vs EMEA), account tier splits (Tier 1/2/3).
- Deployment interest (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC/on-prem) as a key segmentation.

OUT (for this pilot)
- Multi-touch “perfect attribution” across all channels (we’ll do a pragmatic model described below).
- Product usage analytics beyond what’s required to connect lead source + form routing to HubSpot.

Glossary (high-level)
- Target Account: account on the curated ABM list (FinServ/Healthcare sheets). Primary reporting unit.
- Engaged Account: target account showing meaningful intent within the pilot window (definition below).
- Qualified Meeting: meeting that includes one of the core personas and matches pilot ICP (definition below).
- POC: time-bounded technical evaluation with agreed success criteria and Redwood SE involvement.
- Security Review: explicit security/GRC process initiated by prospect (e.g., questionnaire, evidence request, security call).
- Procurement: legal/procurement steps initiated (MSA/DPA/BAA/SLA negotiation, vendor onboarding, security addendum redlines).

Cohort definition (critical)
- Pilot window: 2026-01-08 through 2026-03-06 (adjust final date when pilot ends)
- ABM account cohort = companies marked as “ABM Pilot: Regulated 2026Q1 = TRUE” AND “ABM Vertical = FinServ or Healthcare”.
- When reporting “conversion rates”, denominator is cohort size unless explicitly called out.

Funnel stages + definitions (Engagement → Meetings → POC → Security Review → Procurement)

Stage 0 — Targeted (baseline)
Definition
- Account is on the ABM target list and is in HubSpot with required fields populated.
Entry criteria (HubSpot)
- Company property: ABM Pilot: Regulated 2026Q1 = TRUE
- Company property: ABM Vertical ∈ {FinServ, Healthcare}
- Company property: ABM Tier ∈ {1,2,3}

Stage 1 — Engaged (account-level)
Definition (any ONE of the following in the pilot window)
- High-intent website action: visited regulated landing page AND submitted form OR booked meeting.
- Attended webinar/roundtable (registered + attended OR asked a question).
- Replied to outbound email with non-negative intent (manual classification OK).
- Requested security materials (e.g., security FAQ addendum, reference architecture) via link click + follow-up request.

Operational definition (for consistent reporting)
- Engaged Account = ABM target account with Engagement Score ≥ 3.
Engagement scoring rubric (simple + auditable)
- +3 = form submission on ABM landing page OR meeting booked
- +2 = webinar attended OR explicit “send security materials / NDA / questionnaire” request
- +1 = any tracked click on ABM email OR ≥2 pageviews on regulated docs pages within 7 days
- Cap at 6 (we’re tracking directionally, not as a lead score model)

Stage 2 — Qualified Meeting (meeting-level, counted at account-level)
Definition
- A completed meeting scheduled as part of the pilot that includes at least one of:
  - CISO / Security / GRC / Privacy
  - Platform Engineering / Infrastructure
  - ML Engineering / Applied AI
- AND the meeting objective is one of:
  - Private/VPC/on-prem architecture discussion
  - Dedicated capacity sizing
  - Security readiness / evidence review
  - POC scoping
Exclusions
- “Intro / partnership / recruiting” meetings
- Generic product demo with no regulated constraints discussed

Stage 3 — POC (evaluation)
POC minimum bar (all required)
- Documented success criteria (latency/throughput/cost and at least one security constraint)
- Named technical owner on prospect side
- Redwood SE assigned
- POC timeline ≤ 4 weeks (exceptions require Markus Klein approval)

POC sub-stages (helpful for weekly movement)
- POC Scoped (success criteria + plan agreed)
- POC Started (access granted / endpoints provisioned / test traffic flowing)
- POC Completed (results reviewed, decision next steps identified)

Stage 4 — Security Review (security/GRC motion)
Definition
- Any of:
  - Security questionnaire received
  - Evidence requests list received (SOC2 report under NDA, pen test summary, architecture diagrams, etc.)
  - Security review call held with Security/GRC stakeholders
- Count “Security Review Started” at the first timestamped artifact (email request, ticket, meeting).

Security review outcome buckets
- In Progress
- Blocked (waiting on NDA / waiting on evidence / waiting on customer)
- Satisfied (security sign-off or clear path)

Stage 5 — Procurement (commercial + legal)
Definition
- Explicit procurement/legal steps initiated:
  - MSA redlines
  - DPA/BAA request (healthcare)
  - SLA review
  - Vendor onboarding (bank/payments)
  - PO / invoice / marketplace purchase intent

Procurement outcome buckets
- In Progress
- Blocked (legal, vendor onboarding, budget)
- Closed Won
- Closed Lost (record reason)

Primary KPI set (what goes on the weekly exec snapshot)
Account volume + movement
- # Target Accounts (cohort size)
- # Engaged Accounts
- # Accounts w/ Qualified Meeting
- # Accounts w/ POC Scoped
- # Accounts w/ POC Started
- # Accounts w/ Security Review Started
- # Accounts w/ Procurement Started

Conversion rates (account-level)
- Engaged / Targeted
- Qualified Meeting / Engaged
- POC Scoped / Qualified Meeting
- Security Review Started / POC Started
- Procurement Started / Security Review Started

Speed metrics (median days between milestones)
- Days: Engaged → Qualified Meeting
- Days: Qualified Meeting → POC Scoped
- Days: POC Started → Security Review Started
- Days: Security Review Started → Procurement Started

Pipeline + $ metrics
- $ Pipeline Created (sum of deal Amount where Create Date in pilot window and ABM Pilot = TRUE)
- $ Pipeline Influenced (existing deals where ABM engagement occurred in pilot window; definition below)
- # Deals Created
- Avg deal size (Created)
- Stage distribution (Created + Active)

Quality/fit indicators (to ensure we aren’t “meeting stuffing”)
- % Qualified Meetings that include Security/GRC within 14 days of first meeting
- % POCs with defined security constraints captured (checkbox)
- Top 3 blockers by count (security, data residency, pricing, latency, etc.)

Segmentation cuts required (every metric above should be filterable)
- ABM Vertical: FinServ vs Healthcare
- ABM Tier: 1/2/3
- Region: NA vs EMEA
- Deployment Interest: Dedicated vs Private/VPC vs On-prem interest (if captured)
- Persona reached: Security/GRC vs Platform vs ML Eng (based on meeting attendees/contact roles)

Attribution notes (pragmatic model)
We will report 3 lenses side-by-side:
1) Sourced (strict)
- Deal is “ABM Sourced” if:
  - Deal Create Date in pilot window AND
  - Primary associated company has ABM Pilot: Regulated 2026Q1 = TRUE AND
  - Original Source for the primary contact is one of: ABM Landing Page / ABM Webinar / ABM Outbound

2) Influenced (lightweight)
- Deal is “ABM Influenced” if:
  - Associated company is in ABM cohort AND
  - Any ABM campaign touch occurred in pilot window (email click, form, webinar) AND
  - Deal is in an open stage or progressed stage during pilot window

3) Activity-driven (for weekly iteration)
- Count of meetings, POCs, security reviews that can be tied to ABM plays regardless of whether the deal already existed.

Important caveats to include on dashboard
- “Influenced” is directional and should not be used for comp calculations.
- Some security reviews happen before formal deals exist (especially in Healthcare); we track those as Stage 4 even without a deal.

HubSpot implementation — required objects + properties

Company properties (required)
- ABM Pilot: Regulated 2026Q1 (boolean)
- ABM Vertical (enum: FinServ, Healthcare)
- ABM Tier (enum: 1,2,3)
- ABM Owner (AE name)
- ABM SDR Owner (SDR name)
- Deployment Interest (enum: Hosted, Dedicated, Private/VPC, On-prem, Unknown)
- Data Sensitivity (enum: Regulated/PHI/PCI/PII, Non-regulated, Unknown)
- Security Review Status (enum: Not Started, In Progress, Blocked, Satisfied)
- Procurement Status (enum: Not Started, In Progress, Blocked, Closed)
- Primary Competitor Mentioned (free text / optional)

Contact properties (required)
- Persona (enum: CISO/Security, GRC/Compliance, Platform Eng, ML Eng, Data/Privacy, Procurement/Legal, Other)
- Buying Role (enum: Champion, Economic buyer, Technical evaluator, Blocker, Unknown)
- Opt-in status (standard HubSpot)

Deal properties (required)
- ABM Pilot: Regulated 2026Q1 (boolean; mirror from company on deal create; do not rely solely on association)
- Vertical (enum: FinServ, Healthcare, Other)
- Deployment SKU (enum: Hosted, Dedicated, Private)
- POC Status (enum: Not Started, Scoped, Started, Completed, N/A)
- POC Start Date (date)
- Security Review Start Date (date)
- Procurement Start Date (date)
- Next Step Date (date)
- Deal Source Detail (enum: ABM Outbound, ABM Landing Page, ABM Webinar, Partner, Inbound non-ABM, Expansion, Other)

Campaign / UTM requirements (ENG-2941 + PR_27119 dependency)
- All ABM landing pages must capture and pass through UTMs to HubSpot:
  - utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_content, utm_term
- Standard utm_campaign naming
  - regulated_abm_2026q1_finserv_<asset>
  - regulated_abm_2026q1_healthcare_<asset>
Examples
- regulated_abm_2026q1_finserv_lp
- regulated_abm_2026q1_healthcare_webinar
- regulated_abm_2026q1_finserv_outbound_seq1

Form routing rules (to reduce noise + speed follow-up)
- If ABM Pilot = TRUE OR utm_campaign matches regulated_abm_2026q1_*:
  - Create task for assigned SDR within 1 business hour
  - Slack notification to #sales-abm-regulated (or current equivalent) with company + persona + asset
  - Auto-enroll contact into “ABM Regulated - Nurture (Light)” only if no meeting booked within 48 hours

Data hygiene + governance
- Single source of truth for ABM cohort: the ABM target account lists (FinServ/Healthcare). Tyler/Isabelle will import/update weekly.
- Do not overwrite existing lifecycle stage logic; use the ABM Pilot boolean + ABM Vertical/Tier for reporting filters.
- Any manual “Engaged” scoring adjustments must be logged in Notes (include date + initials).

Dashboard layout (recommended)
Tab 1 — Exec Snapshot
- Funnel counts + conversion rates (overall + by vertical)
- Median days between milestones
- Pipeline created/influenced
- Top blockers (bar chart)

Tab 2 — Channel Performance (iteration)
- Outbound: sends, opens (directional), replies, positive replies, meetings booked
- Landing pages: views, CVR to form submit, CVR to meeting booked
- Webinar: registrations, attendance rate, meetings booked within 14 days

Tab 3 — Account Movement (operational)
- Table of Tier 1 accounts with current stage, last activity date, next step, owner
- Highlight accounts “Stuck” (no activity in 14 days) and “Hot” (security request within 7 days)

Tab 4 — Data Quality
- % of cohort with ABM Tier populated
- % with Deployment Interest populated
- % of deals with POC Status populated
- Missing field report (by owner)

Definitions for “meetings booked” and “completed”
- Booked = meeting scheduled on calendar with at least one Redwood rep + at least one prospect attendee; must be logged in HubSpot.
- Completed = meeting occurred and outcome note logged (even brief). Use “Meeting Outcome” property if available; otherwise meeting notes required.

Open questions / decisions needed
1) Do we want Security Review to require a formal deal? Recommendation: NO (security often precedes deal creation in regulated).
2) Should webinar attendance count as Engaged if it’s a partner-hosted invite? Recommendation: YES if we can match domain to target account.
3) How do we handle parent/subsidiary account mapping (banks, health systems)? Recommendation: roll up to the entity in the ABM list; keep subsidiaries associated but report at parent.

Change log
- 2026-01-08 (IL): v0 created; baseline funnel definitions + required fields.
- 2026-01-15 (IL/TB): added UTM naming + form routing requirements (ENG-2941).
- 2026-01-29 (IL/MK/OP): clarified Security Review and Procurement definitions + outcome buckets.
- 2026-02-14 (IL): added speed metrics + quality indicators; tightened “Qualified Meeting” exclusion criteria.
